title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode1 A New Year's Promise

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great.
It's a little chilly this morning, but it's really nice out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'll do some stretches as usual here before heading back.)

Hello there, Haruka.
As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Enomoto, good morning.
You must be busy as well this time of year being a Shrine Maiden and all.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line:
I could say the same for you.
It's incredible how you go out for a run every morning despite it being so cold out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, I really enjoy exercising like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But it's almost New Year's Eve.
I'm sure you've been getting a lot of people lately.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: Yes, we have. We run ourselves ragged every year around this time to keep this place going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I can tell...
But it's been getting very cold at night, so please make sure to keep warm.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line:
Thank you!
As busy as it gets, I actually have a lot of fun seeing all these people stop by to pray and make their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: They're all trying to make their futures as bright and prosperous as possible, so I'd like to help them achieve their goals in whatever way I can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so noble of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was the recipient of that support a while back too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I remember visiting this shrine right after I became the lead for ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I recall correctly, that was also when Ms. Enomoto came to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I felt so much better after that little chat.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure there are plenty of people out there who are grateful for the support you're giving them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I wish you the best this year.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now, if you'll excuse me.
Happy holidays.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... Showering right after a run always feels so good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll be discussing plans regarding our New Year's stream later tonight, so I think I'll try coming up with some ideas until...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Haruka! Airi! Shizuku!
I have some ideas for our New Year's stream!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Whoa, this is pretty long...
Hehe. She came up with so many.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <They all sound really good. Let's talk about which we can do tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Okay! Oh, I'd like to change subjects before I forget...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <How about we all go visit a shrine together on New Year's?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <We were so busy practicing for our New Year's stream last year that we didn't get a chance...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <But we're doing it on the second this time, so I was thinking that we could all go on New Year's Day!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Would that be alright?
Oh, but it's okay if you can't go!!!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I keep forgetting how many stickers and stamps Minori has. I've never seen this one before... “Will you consider it?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Sure, I should be free to go.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, that's great.
Airi and Shizuku can go too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I think I know just the shrine we can all go to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I know a good shrine that we can visit.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We get to visit it together. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know it won't be easy, but I really want to introduce them to Ms. Enomoto if possible...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It'd be great to show her that we're all still trying our best as idols...)
